readiness_source: No entry here asserts that a fetch will succeed. Data access runs on the Kabo platform through data_connector_run; call data_connector_catalog for the authoritative connector ready / operation implemented state. The user configures no key, no CLI and no Python environment.
retirement_note: The five V1 creator skills this catalog used to resolve (pp-youtube, head-youtube-research, yt-reverse-viral-reels, yt-youtube-research-agent, yt-detect-creator-breakouts) were retired on 2026-08-16 in the platform's V2 changeover, and their wrapper contracts were removed with them. The V2 skills bundle their own scripts/ and references/ inside the signed package and resolve them relative to the skill directory, so nothing published resolves through this file any more. The file stays as a defence for the V1 cache residual window, not because guidance section C maps ../../config/ here - that map names ../../wrappers/ too, and wrappers/ is deleted. The map only fires when a SKILL.md body literally writes ../../, which no V2 body does; a cached V1 body awaiting revocation still does, and what it must find here is this accurate empty skills map rather than a missing file, whereas a kept wrappers/ could only have described five retired skills as still shipping.
